Re: Prediction Markets; Public Interest Determinations, RIN 3038-AF65

Please see the attached file, cftc-comment-ranieri.txt, for the full text of this comment, submitted by Gianlorenzo Ranieri, Founder, Convexly (convexly.app), an independent provider of market-quality measurement and published research on prediction markets.

Summary: Convexly is not affiliated with, invested in, or compensated by any exchange, designated contract market, broker, or trading firm. We comment because the proposal's public interest framework turns, in significant part, on empirical questions about market quality that independent measurement can help answer. We respectfully recommend that, in finalizing Appendix F, the Commission: (1) treat observable market-quality and integrity metrics as relevant evidence in public interest determinations where such evidence is available; (2) expect published, versioned, reproducible methodology behind any metric relied upon in a determination, with limitations and unfavorable results disclosed; and (3) remain source-neutral as to the source of such evidence. We ask for nothing in this comment, and nothing in it should be read as a request for any role, designation, recognition, or commercial preference for Convexly or for independent data providers generally.
attributes.title: Comment on CFTC-2026-1189, CFTC-2026-1189-0001, Convexly
